name: @react-querybuilder/vue
description: Vue component for complex query building
author: Jake Boone

scripts.build: bun run build:main && bun run build:types && bun run build:css
scripts.build:types: vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declarationDir dist && find dist \( -name '*.test.*' -o -name '*.test-d.*' -o -name '*.spec.*' \) -delete && bun ./scripts/normalize-sfc-declarations.ts
scripts.build:css: mkdir -p dist/styles && cp ../../node_modules/@react-querybuilder/core/dist/*.scss dist && cp ../../node_modules/@react-querybuilder/core/dist/styles/*.scss dist/styles && cp -f src/styles/*.scss dist/styles 2>/dev/null || true; bun sass --style=compressed dist
scripts.conformance: bun run conformance:fetch && bun run conformance:test
